description: ELSA, published by IdahoLabResearch, builds OpenMC regions, materials and geometries, including reusable submodels and three-dimensional extrusion or revolution from two-dimensional profiles. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Numerical correctness and compatibility have not been independently tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: ELSA prepares geometry and material definitions for model-openmc.
